products.name: Pegasus Trail 4 GORE-TEX
products.description: Waterproof trail runner engineered for transitions between road and rugged terrain. Built with a GORE-TEX membrane, responsive Nike React foam cushioning, and an all-terrain lugged rubber outsole.

products.name: Ultraboost Light
products.description: High-mileage performance road runner engineered with 30% lighter Light Boost cushioning. Features a foot-wrapping PRIMEKNIT+ textile upper and a Continental™ Better Rubber outsole for superior traction.

products.name: Dunk Low Retro
products.description: Iconic basketball shoe turned streetwear staple with crisp leather overlays and vintage styling. Finished with a padded low-cut collar, perforated toe box ventilation, and classic rubber cupsole traction.

products.name: 2002R Triple Black
products.description: Modern technical runner clad in a stealth monochromatic execution. Combines premium suede and breathable mesh uppers with an ABZORB midsole and Stability Web arch support for exceptional shock absorption.

products.name: GEL-Kayano 14
products.description: Late-2000s technical running silhouette reimagined for lifestyle wear. Delivers signature retro aesthetics alongside visible rearfoot and forefoot GEL™ technology cushioning and a TRUSSTIC™ support chassis.
